The '''Deryvia system''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Deryvian snake]]s.<ref name="Easy Credits" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Deryvia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-14.<ref name="TEA" />
